findings.issue: safe() only strips control characters, so a matched path can still begin a log line with '::'. A root-level file such as '::error::x.perf.test.ts' matches PERF_TEST and is printed on its own stdout line, which the runner parses as a workflow command. Spec section 8 says a crafted file name cannot inject a workflow command, which is not quite true.
findings.evidence: fork PR author adds file '::error title=x::y.perf.test.ts' (or '::add-mask::...perf.test.ts', '::stop-commands::...') -> git diff --name-only -z -> isToolingPath (PERF_TEST) -> main() writes safe(path) as its own line -> runner interprets ::cmd::. The impact is limited to fake annotations, masking or stopping commands in the log for the rest of this step. GITHUB_OUTPUT is written separately as tooling=<bool>. Any injected set-output value has to end in '.perf.test.ts', so it can't set tooling=false. No secrets, read-only token, and set-env/add-path are disabled.
findings.fix: Indent each listed path (e.g. '  ' + safe(p)) so no line starts with '::'. Or wrap the list in '::stop-commands::<random token>' ... '::<token>::'. Add a test for a path that starts with '::'.

findings.issue: The new jobs (especially changes, with fetch-depth: 0) use actions/checkout with the default persist-credentials: true, which leaves the GITHUB_TOKEN in .git/config for later steps (npm ci lifecycle scripts, tests). This matches the existing jobs and the token is contents: read only, so there is no reachable escalation.
findings.evidence: checkout default -> token in .git/config -> readable by subsequent npm ci / test processes; token scope is contents: read.
findings.fix: Optionally add 'persist-credentials: false' to the checkout steps. The changes job only needs local git history, which fetch-depth: 0 already provides.

summary: No BLOCKER or MAJOR issues. Untrusted event data (base/head SHAs, default branch) is passed only through env: and quoted shell variables, never through ${{ }} inside run:. The detector checks SHAs against /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/ and the branch name against a safe charset (and prefixes it with origin/) before calling git through spawnSync without a shell, so option or command injection is not possible. If the base can't be determined it fails closed (tooling=true). Only tooling=<bool> goes to GITHUB_OUTPUT, and the job output is used only in an if: expression. The only other ${{ }} in run: is the static matrix.shard. Workflow-level permissions are still contents: read with no job overrides. The trigger is pull_request, not pull_request_target, so fork PRs get a read-only token and no secrets. Action pins are unchanged full SHAs and no new third-party actions or dependencies were added. On the schedule trigger only changes and tooling run, with read-only permissions. One MINOR: a file name can still start a workflow-command line (cosmetic only). One NIT: persist-credentials.
